entry.title: Leather Rose Petite Corona — Single
entry.eyebrow: Sweet, spicy dark-aromatic Petite Corona test
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, dark rum, cola (projected)
Occasion: Quick rich smoke, dessert smoke, aromatic benchmark
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, oak, white pepper, earth and pronounced sweetness make Leather Rose one of the darker, punchier aromatic Deadwood options. Drew Estate rates the line full-bodied, while the compact 4″ × 43 Petite Corona keeps the smoke short enough to work as a genuine taster rather than a long-format commitment. The Brazilian maduro wrapper over Indonesian binder and Nicaraguan filler should put it much closer to the catalogue’s preferred sweet, peppery and dark profile than most flavoured cigars. Untasted here, so Strength 8 and Quality 7 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. CigarHut currently lists the exact 4″ × 43 Leather Rose Petite Corona single at A$29, with Single / 10 Cigars / Box of 24 options.
